title: Shield's +1 Might is not reflected in Zephyr Sage's current/displayed Might while it is the designated defender in a combat showdown
expected: render/card.js:199-205 computes effMight = base + meta.mightModifier + meta.staticMightBonus + (buffed?1:0) + equipmentMightBonus — no term for Shield (or Assault) keyed on meta.combatRole, so a Shield defender's badge never changes. Engine-side, Shield is only added inside combat/combat-resolver.ts:96/109 (calculateSideMight / per-unit bonus during resolution) and is never folded into mightModifier/staticMightBonus on the card, so /api state and __rbGameState also report might=6. The only UI place that adds Shield is the combat preview total in gameplay/combat.js:101-104, not the per-card display. Rule 432.1.a states a defending Shield unit's *current* Might includes Shield, so Zephyr Sage should read 7 while combatRole==='defender'.
observed: During the combat showdown (combatRole='defender' confirmed in state) the board card showed no modified-might badge (printed 6), client __rbGameState might=6 and /api state might=6; the attacker's +3 mightModifier DID render as a '6' badge, so the UI folds mightModifier/buff/equipment but not Shield-while-defender (card.js effective-might calc). Shield was only applied inside combat resolution.
